generator.G: <int> Number of generators owned by the power producer.
generator.C_lower_MW: <int> Minimum generation output in megawatts when the generator is running.
generator.C_upper_MW: <int> Maximum generation output in megawatts when the generator is running.
generator.V_plus_MW_per_h: <int> Maximum increase in generation level allowed between consecutive time periods, in megawatts per period.
generator.V_minus_MW_per_h: <int> Maximum decrease in generation level allowed between consecutive time periods, in megawatts per period.
generator.U_bar_startup_cost_dollars: <int> Fixed cost in dollars incurred each time the generator is turned on.
generator.U_lower_shutdown_cost_dollars: <int> Fixed cost in dollars incurred each time the generator is turned off.
generator.fuel_cost_type: <str> Type of fuel cost function used to model operating costs.
generator.fuel_cost_formula: <str> Mathematical formula expressing the fuel cost as a function of generation level.
generator.fuel_a_dollars_per_h: <float> Fixed hourly operating cost in dollars incurred whenever the generator is running.
generator.fuel_b_dollars_per_MWh: <float> Variable operating cost in dollars per megawatt-hour of electricity produced.
generator.fuel_cost_note: <str> Explanatory note about the fuel cost approximation used.

scenario_tree.T_num_periods: <int> Total number of time periods in the planning horizon.
scenario_tree.K_branches_per_node: <int> Number of child nodes branching from each non-leaf node in the scenario tree.
scenario_tree.L_min_up_time: <int> Minimum number of consecutive periods the generator must remain on after being started.
scenario_tree.ell_min_down_time: <int> Minimum number of consecutive periods the generator must remain off after being shut down.
scenario_tree.total_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the scenario tree.
scenario_tree.num_leaf_nodes: <int> Number of leaf nodes representing final-period outcomes in the scenario tree.
scenario_tree.num_scenarios: <int> Total number of distinct root-to-leaf paths in the scenario tree.
scenario_tree.initial_generator_status_y0: <int> On/off status of the generator immediately before the first period (1 = on, 0 = off).
scenario_tree.initial_generation_x0_MW: <float> Generation level in megawatts immediately before the first period.
scenario_tree.electricity_price_range_dollars_per_MWh: <list[float], length 2> Lower and upper bounds of the electricity price distribution in dollars per megawatt-hour.
scenario_tree.electricity_price_distribution: <str> Probability distribution from which electricity prices at each node are drawn.
scenario_tree.nodes: <list[object], length total_nodes> List of all nodes in the scenario tree, each containing the fields below.

nodes[*].id: <int> Unique identifier for this node in the scenario tree.
nodes[*].time: <int> Time period associated with this node, starting from 1.
nodes[*].parent_id: <int or null> Identifier of this node's parent node, or null for the root node.
nodes[*].children_ids: <list[int]> Identifiers of all child nodes branching from this node.
nodes[*].probability: <float> Probability of reaching this node from the root of the scenario tree.
nodes[*].electricity_price_dollars_per_MWh: <float> Electricity market price at this node in dollars per megawatt-hour.
